items.title: Joint Gaussianity and continuum GFF characterisation from ball domain Markov scaling, boundary-sensitive fourth moments and spherical-harmonic processes
items.difficulty_reason: Allow the covariance-as-Green support, Bocher/Green characterisation, the BPR mean-value/mollifier inputs, Brownian hitting and explicit Green estimates, standard spherical harmonics, Green second identity, Kolmogorov and Kallenberg continuous-independent-increment Gaussianity. The remaining coupled author construction is the boundary-sensitive weak Wick estimate under a ball-only DMP: cut-ball harmonic measures cannot be handled directly, so the argument enlarges to2B, decomposes back and cancels cross terms; when three points cluster and the product bound fails, a second cancellation identity reorganises the correction into Green products. This is combined with exact mixed weighted spherical-harmonic increment structures and nested-ball decompositions that turn varying-radius vectors into independent Gaussian tuples. These estimate/cancellation and joint-process constructions form oneH3framework. The simple Green-second-identity lemma, covariance support and basis closure are not separate advanced cores. Preserve the explicitly authored model-plus-similar-case sketch for the cluster identity at520; do not claim all key identities have fully expanded proofs.
